answer: Make each new identity earn its key with a sequential proof-of-wait puzzle taking six hours, impossible to parallelize: no rented oasis of machines can shorten one falcon's solo flight. While waiting it wears a violet badge and cannot trade. The puzzle binds to one device fingerprint; a fingerprint caught farming is banned for 12 epochs with pending rewards burned. Each puzzle costs 8,000 POA in compute, so fielding 1,000 fakes costs 8,000,000 POA while one honest agent pays 8,000 once. Limitation: the fixed wait punishes honest newcomers on slow hardware most.
